name: SaaS & Web Application UX
description: Specialized UX heuristics for SaaS products, B2B/B2C web apps, dashboards, and subscription workflows.

name.tr: Değer Önerisi ve İlk Değere Ulaşma Süresi

description.en: Users should immediately grasp what the product does, who it is for, and how to start. Onboarding steps, templates, or interactive previews should minimize Time-to-Value (TTV).
description.tr: Kullanıcılar ürünün ne işe yaradığını, kimin için olduğunu ve nasıl başlayacaklarını anında anlamalıdır. Onboarding adımları ve şablonlar ilk değere ulaşma süresini (TTV) en aza indirmelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clear headline/value proposition on landing pages or guided onboarding checklists inside the app, low-friction sign-up/trial start, and immediate visual product context.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Value Proposition & Time-to-Value (Onboarding)'. Does it clearly communicate product value and guide users to their first meaningful outcome quickly?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Vague buzzwords, unclear product purpose, dead-end start experience
scoring_rubric.21-40: High friction to get started, confusing positioning or unguided setup
scoring_rubric.41-60: Value is understandable with effort, standard signup/setup flow
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear value proposition and guided entry path with minor friction
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — instant clarity, frictionless onboarding, rapid time-to-value

description.en: Dashboards, tables, and analytics views must balance data density with scannability—using clear card grouping, progressive disclosure, legible typography, and semantic status colors.
description.tr: Paneller, tablolar ve analitik görünümler veri yoğunluğu ile taranabilirliği dengelemeli; net kart gruplaması, aşamalı gösterim, okunaklı tipografi ve anlamsal durum renkleri kullanmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: scannable KPI cards, well-aligned tables/lists, clear separation between primary metrics and secondary metadata, and progressive disclosure (modals/drawers/expandables) for deep details.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Dashboard Hierarchy & Information Density'. Is complex data organized with clear visual hierarchy, whitespace, and scannable groupings?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Overwhelming wall of unformatted data, competing metrics, illegible layout
scoring_rubric.21-40: Cramped cards/tables, poor alignment, difficult to scan key metrics
scoring_rubric.41-60: Functional layout but visually dense or lacking clear primary focus
scoring_rubric.61-80: Well-structured interface with good hierarchy and minor density issues
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — balanced density, crisp typography, effortless metric scanning

name.tr: Çalışma Alanı Navigasyonu ve Yön Bulma

description.en: Users must always know where they are within the app hierarchy (active sidebar item, breadcrumbs, workspace/project switcher) and switch between core modules effortlessly.
description.tr: Kullanıcılar uygulama hiyerarşisinde nerede olduklarını (aktif menü öğesi, breadcrumb, çalışma alanı/proje seçici) her zaman bilmeli ve modüller arasında zahmetsizce geçiş yapabilmelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clear active state in sidebar/top navigation, logical grouping of nav items (5-7 top-level groups), visible account/workspace context, and predictable navigation behavior.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Workspace Navigation & Wayfinding'. Can users immediately tell where they are and navigate across features without getting lost?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Confusing navigation, no active states, users easily lose context
scoring_rubric.21-40: Bloated or inconsistent menus, unclear workspace/page location
scoring_rubric.41-60: Standard navigation present but lacks clear grouping or active indicators
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear navigation and active states with minor organizational gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — intuitive information architecture, crisp wayfinding cues

name.tr: Boş Durumlar (Empty States) ve Yükleme Deneyimi

description.en: Blank screens or empty tables should never feel broken. Empty states must explain why the area is empty and provide a direct CTA or sample data to populate it.
description.tr: Boş ekranlar veya tablolar asla bozuk hissi vermemelidir. Boş durumlar (empty states) alanın neden boş olduğunu açıklamalı ve doldurmak için doğrudan bir CTA veya örnek veri sunmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: helpful empty state illustrations/copy with a primary 'Create / Import' button, skeleton loaders instead of jarring layout shifts, and informative zero-search-result guidance.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Empty States, Zero-Data & Loading UX'. Are empty areas, initial states, or loading transitions handled constructively with clear next actions?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Blank white areas or raw 'No data' text with zero guidance on what to do next
scoring_rubric.21-40: Unhelpful empty states, jarring layout jumps, unclear next steps
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic empty/loading messages exist but lack actionable buttons or context
scoring_rubric.61-80: Helpful empty states and state transitions with minor polish needed
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — educational empty states with direct CTAs and smooth state feedback

name.tr: İş Akışı Verimliliği, Toplu İşlemler ve Kısayollar

description.en: Repetitive SaaS tasks should be accelerated through command palettes (Cmd+K), keyboard shortcuts, bulk selection/actions, saved filters, and inline editing.
description.tr: Tekrarlayan SaaS görevleri; komut paleti (Cmd+K), klavye kısayolları, toplu seçim/işlemler, kayıtlı filtreler ve satır içi düzenleme ile hızlandırılmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: global search or command bar, filter/sort persistence, bulk checkboxes on lists, keyboard shortcut hints in tooltips, and minimal clicks for frequent workflows.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Workflow Efficiency, Bulk Actions & Shortcuts'. Does the interface empower frequent users with fast search, filters, shortcuts, or streamlined workflows?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Tedious multi-click workflows for basic actions, no search or filtering
scoring_rubric.21-40: Rigid interface requiring repetitive manual steps, poor keyboard support
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic search/controls exist but power-user accelerators are missing
scoring_rubric.61-80: Good workflow speed with search/filters and some efficiency shortcuts
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — command palette/shortcuts, bulk actions, low-click workflows

name.en: Pricing Tiers, Feature Gating & Upgrade Clarity
name.tr: Fiyat Paketleri, Özellik Kısıtları ve Yükseltme Netliği

description.en: Plan comparisons, usage quotas, billing cycles (monthly/annual), and locked-feature indicators must be transparent and easy to compare without hidden enterprise traps.
description.tr: Paket karşılaştırmaları, kullanım kotaları, fatura dönemleri (aylık/yıllık) ve kilitli özellik göstergeleri şeffaf ve kolay karşılaştırılabilir olmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: scannable tier differentiation, clear monthly vs. annual toggle, transparent usage limits/meters, and non-intrusive upgrade prompts for gated features.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Pricing Tiers, Feature Gating & Upgrade Clarity'. Are plan differences, usage limits, or account capabilities communicated transparently?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Confusing or deceptive pricing/feature limits, aggressive paywall traps
scoring_rubric.21-40: Hard to compare tiers or understand what is included in the current plan
scoring_rubric.41-60: Standard pricing/plan info present but feature differences require heavy reading
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear tier breakdown or quota indicators with minor clarity gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — crystal-clear plan comparison, transparent quotas, respectful upgrade cues

name.tr: İşlem Geri Bildirimi, Otomatik Kayıt ve Silme Güvenliği

description.en: Every state change (saving, syncing, exporting, deleting) needs clear feedback. Destructive actions (delete workspace, revoke API key) must require explicit confirmation or offer undo.
description.tr: Her durum değişikliği (kaydetme, senkronizasyon, dışa aktarma, silme) net geri bildirim gerektirir. Yıkıcı eylemler açık onay istemeli veya geri alma (undo) sunmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clear 'Saved' / 'Unsaved changes' indicators, disabled/loading button states during async requests, semantic danger styling (red) for destructive actions, and undo/confirmation dialogs.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Action Feedback, Auto-Save & Destructive Safety'. Does the app clearly communicate sync/save status and protect users from accidental data loss?

scoring_rubric.0-20: No feedback on actions, high risk of accidental data loss or double submission
scoring_rubric.21-40: Inconsistent state indicators, destructive buttons look identical to normal buttons
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic button states exist but save/sync confidence could be stronger
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear state badges and safe action patterns with minor gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — unmistakable sync/save states, safe destructive flows, undo support

name.tr: Bağlamsal Yardım, İpuçları ve Öz-Hizmet Desteği

description.en: Complex SaaS settings, technical terms, and integrations should include inline helper text, info tooltips, documentation links, or an accessible help widget.
description.tr: Karmaşık SaaS ayarları, teknik terimler ve entegrasyonlar satır içi açıklama metinleri, bilgi ipuçları (tooltip), dokümantasyon bağlantıları veya erişilebilir bir yardım aracı içermelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: inline descriptions under complex form controls, '(?)' info tooltips for domain metrics, direct 'Learn more' documentation links, and accessible support/status links.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Contextual Help, Tooltips & Self-Service Support'. Are complex features explained inline with tooltips, helper text, and accessible documentation?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Cryptic settings/metrics with zero explanation or documentation links
scoring_rubric.21-40: Minimal help, users must leave the app and guess technical terminology
scoring_rubric.41-60: General help link in header/footer, but lacking inline contextual guidance
scoring_rubric.61-80: Good helper text and documentation links in most complex areas
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — seamless inline help, clear tooltips, comprehensive self-service docs
